frase_gancho.texto: A sixteenth-century Franciscan convent that is now a cathedral and a World Heritage Site.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: You are entering an old Franciscan convent founded in the first half of the sixteenth century. Since eighteen ninety-one it has been a cathedral, and since nineteen ninety-four it has been part of the earliest sixteenth-century monasteries on the slopes of the Popocatépetl, declared a World Heritage Site. Here lives the layer of faith. The complex includes the atrium, the open chapel, the nave with its murals, the cloister, the museum, and the church of the Third Order.
